info.name: Marketplace Platform — Customer API
info.description: Postman collection for the Customer-facing API (`routes/api_customer.php`). Country-scoped endpoints live under `/v1/{country}/...`; several endpoints are country-agnostic under `/v1/...`. Auth uses JWT bearer tokens issued by the Auth folder's Register/Login/Refresh Token requests — their test scripts auto-populate the `access_token` and `refresh_token` collection variables.
